# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine. This release also hardens pixel and stream lifetimes, improves allocation-sensitive APIs, and expands supported native package coverage.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through Chrome m152 servicing** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates later stability and use-after-free fixes from upstream servicing. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backends exposed** — Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to target the newer GPU architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support for non-blocking pixel retrieval. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New Vulkan Silk.NET package available** — Restores production packaging for the Vulkan Silk.NET integration so applications can consume its GPU bindings. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel-source lifetimes protected** — Keeps source objects alive while extracting pixmap subsets and resolving SKRegion spans, preventing native use-after-free failures. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Raster image creation no longer leaks failed pixel buffers** — Releases CoTaskMem pixel buffers when SKImage.Create cannot create a raster image. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **HarfBuzz stream conversion releases assets** — Disposes the non-memory-backed SKStreamAsset used when creating HarfBuzz blobs. ([#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support uses FreeType** — Bundles FreeType support for fonts on Nano Server, improving text rendering on that Windows deployment target. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Apple native symbol packages produced** — Publishes native symbols with Apple packages to improve crash-symbolication support. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Allocation-sensitive APIs streamlined** — Reduces avoidable copying, boxing, string allocation, reflection work, and map resizing in encoding, tags, runtime effects, and handle registration. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzzSharp stream ownership and shaping performance, and updates the package documentation.
